title: WPPIL/161/2016 of Jasveer Singh Vs Director Mahila Sashaktikaran And Bal Vikas Vibhag AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPPIL No. 161 of 2016
Hon'ble Rajiv Sharma, ACJ.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Tapan Singh, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. S.S. Chauhan, Deputy Advocate
General for the State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Parikshit Saini, Advocate for the
intervener.
The short controversy involved in this case
is whether the Anganwadi Center should be
constructed in Government Primary School or on
the land donated by the intervener.
The gist of the counter affidavit filed on
behalf of the respondent State is that as per the
standing instructions, Anganwadi Centre is to be
constructed in the school premises through the
Block Development Office.
The intervener has donated the adjoining
land, measuring 741 Sq ft. for construction of the
Anganwadi Centre, free of cost. The notarized
donation deed was also executed in favour of the
Village Panchayat.
The Court is of the considered view that
the area of the school should not be utilized for
construction of Anganwadi Centers, if alternative
Government land is available or if land is available
by way of donation. In the instant case, land has
been donated by the intervener, namely, Sri
Narottam Dutt Sharma for construction of the
Aaganwadi Centre. The intervener - Shri
Narottam Dutt Sharma is directed to register the
donation deed in the name of the Village
Panchayat, within a period of six weeks from
today. Thereafter, construction shall be raised on
this land through the agency of the Block
Development Office.
Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed
of.
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) (Rajiv Sharma,ACJ.)
